{{Top}}
'''Group Two''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] battle group within the [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] it was commanded by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]]. Pilots of the Group Two flew alongside the other fighters of the Blue Squadron in their [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to fight the advancing [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], and were able to cut a clear path to the [[Procurer]].
